name: infinidysk
description: infinidysk - The NzbDAV successor in Rust. Usenet streaming with a WebDAV server and a SABnzbd-compatible API.

issues.title: Mid-stream switch to a verified alternate NZB without interrupting playback
Remove downloads in unowned categories that nobody has read for N days
infinidysk 2.0 (Rust rewrite): 1.x is in maintenance mode
Support for creating symlink / strm links AND health checks for both
NNTP proxy server: expose our provider pool to SABnzbd/NZBGet over standard NNTP
Repair stream holes using bytes from differently packaged duplicate releases
Complete headless configuration and unattended provisioning for v2
